observed_problem: The canonical config declared operator_model.local_stage_control=COMPACT_AGENT_CHECKPOINT while every orchestration stage still carried handoff_required=true from the legacy Action/Handoff control path. The new agent controller ignored that field, but repository readers and the legacy orchestrator could interpret the same canonical stage plan as requiring Stage Handoffs.
expected_behavior: Canonical configuration must express the same operating model as the authority documents and production workflows. Legacy Handoff machinery may remain for audit/compatibility, but canonical local stages must not advertise Handoff as required.
actual_behavior: All canonical stage_plan entries now set handoff_required=false. The legacy Handoff compatibility fixture explicitly opts into the old requirement when testing that historical path, and the Pilot/bootstrap regression asserts that every canonical stage disables legacy Handoff requirements.
improvement_action: Implemented by disabling legacy Handoff requirements in the canonical stage plan while leaving compatibility code available only through explicit legacy fixtures.
